content:
For Waterproof we'd like to show students until what line has been processed, to help them and us with debugging their proofs.

Currently, the LSP reports it's working on the line with #doc. Could we somehow obtain more finegrained progress?

When I run Verso, it shows a short yellow bar on that line, but the yellow bars in general follow the Verso blocks (paragraphs, code blocks, etc). Do you just see a single big yellow bar until the whole thing finishes?
This behaviour is from our extension, so the fact you're saying this suggests the information we want is available somewhere in the LSP, so I'll do some investigation on that end.

This uses an LSP extension, where it sends the $/lean/fileProgress notification. See https://github.com/leanprover/lean4/blob/e8048291010c815d0d30926924e7ad7afc18b1c0/src/Lean/Server/Utils.lean#L145-L162 for where they come from.

@Pim Otte note that the rocq-lsp version of Waterproof already used $/coq/fileProgress notification which was on purpose made identical to Lean's. So that could of help.

Are you using inline Lean blocks?

As David noted, Verso will report incrementally block-by-block. However, elaboration of lean inline blocks is not as incremental as it could. Lean will report a single progress event for a lean code fence, no matter how many definitions you have inside.

I have a prototype patch improving this.

I'd be happy to push the patch to Verso upstream soon if that would be of help.
We're currently not elaborating inline lean, I'm 95% sure the issue is on our side. There's a student programmer looking into it, I'll cycle back if it turns out unexpected.
